lessons.title: Getting started – Volunteering in the community
objectives: Gain an overview of the topic 'For a better community' and key vocabulary related to voluntary work;
Understand and use words to talk about community volunteer activities;
Identify adjectives with suffixes (-ed, -ing, -ful, -less) and the past simple vs. past continuous in context.
Core Competences:
Develop communicative fluency, active listening, and pair/teamwork collaboration;
Actively join in class activities.
Personal Qualities:
Develop a spirit of community service, compassion, and civic responsibility toward the disadvantaged.
Digital & AI Competences:
1: Use AI tools and online search engines to brainstorm ideas and gather data on community service projects.
1: Identify specific community issues that can be addressed through technology-supported volunteering initiatives.
